title: Association Between ABO Blood Group and Survival Outcomes in Advanced NSCLC Treated with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors.
snippet: Reliable biomarkers that predict outcomes with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remain limited. ABO blood group antigens may influence tumor immunity and response to immunotherapy. We retrospectively analyzed 239 patients with advanced NSCLC treated with ICI-based therapy between 2019 and 2024.
